items.text: We’re thrilled to announce that the "Heroes of Ikonei Island" achievement is now fixed and fully unlockable on Steam! This fix, however, will only work in new saves. If you have an old save and still want the achievement, we can provide you with a save file that will trigger it for you. Please contact us through community@snowcastle.no or open a ticket on our Discord server for further details.
We sincerely thank you for your incredible patience while we worked on this. We know how important it is to see that 100% completion, and we’re glad to finally get this sorted.
Players won’t get stuck around Milas' plane wreckage anymore.
Fixed all the items displaying the wrong sell value.
Updated the main menu to include the link to our latest game, Lysward.
Updated the splash screen.

Please note that this patch is for Steam only. Our team is actively working on the fixes for PlayStation and Xbox, but they require additional development and certification time. We are targeting a console patch release as soon as possible and will share a specific date as soon as we have one. We appreciate your continued patience.
Thank you so much for your support! Your detailed bug reports and patience have been invaluable in helping us squash these issues.
And in the end, YOU are the Heroes of Ikonei! Enjoy the island!
Snowcastle Games

releases.displayName: Lunar Union Event - Rewards Delivery

items.text: Hello, Castaways!

We’ve discovered a bug that prevents players from retrieving items after completing the Lunar Union Festival missions. We know how frustrating this can be, especially after all the effort you’ve put into the event, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

To solve this issue, we’ll be delivering the missing items through the Frog Box—a special mailbox in the game that distributes rewards and other goodies to all players. If you don’t already have a Frog Box, simply speak to Frogboy and he’ll give you one.

You’ll have from February 12th until March 11th to retrieve your rewards from the Frog Box. After that date, the mail will expire, so please make sure to collect your items before then. We wouldn’t want you to miss out!
If you encounter any issues or have questions, feel free to reach out to us here or on Discord.
Thank you so much for your patience and for being part of our community. Your support means the world to us, and we’re committed to making Ikonei Island the best it can be for all Castaways.

And with Valentine's Day coming up why not share the magic of Ikonei Island with the people whose company you 💙 with the Friends' Pass which they play along with you for free! (there is a download link on the store page:

Also, Ikonei Island releases TODAY on Playstation and Xbox! Grab your controller and embark on an unforgettable journey to Ikonei Island! releases.displayName: Update about the console launch!

items.text: So, as you probably noticed, Ikonei Island had a bit of a rocky start here on Steam. Some sneaky bugs managed to slip through the cracks despite all the testing we threw at it. We took that hard, but stepped up and have been hustling to squash those issues.

On the upside, we've managed to roll out not one but two seasonal updates – Lystide during the 2023 Holiday season and, today, Lunar New Year. We really hope you're enjoying the new stuff and grabbing those goodies.

Now, here's the real talk. It's clear to us that there are more improvements that we need to deliver, many inspired by the amazing feedback we have had from your guys. We have things we need to do to make sure the game really delivers on its potential. That's why we're holding off a bit on the PlayStation and Xbox releases. We're working on it and getting extremely close! The updates include significant improvements to usability (UX/UI), onboarding as well as more seasonal content!

We were hoping to announce a confirmed release date today, but we don't want to make promises until everything's locked down. Console releases are like putting together a complex puzzle, and we're making sure all the pieces fit just right.

We know many of you will be super disappointed, but we're not about to deliver anything less than awesome. The improvements and new content we've thrown your way so far are just a glimpse of what's coming. Our aim is to launch on console with all the upgrades and cool stuff by the end of March.
We will share a much more detailed breakdown of the improvements (coming to PC as well) and a confirmed release date in the next few weeks.
In the meantime, here is a small taste of what some of the new UI assets will look like - let us know what you think!
There is no way for us to explain how much it means to us that you are sticking with us, and we can't wait to hear what you think of the changes!
Don't froget to share the magic Ikonei Island's Friends' Pass with other castaways:
We'll croak you on the island! 🐸
Snowcastle Games

releases.displayName: Bugs fixed! - now testing to make sure... (want to help?)

notes.title: We got off to a bit of a rocky start.

items.text: There is no other way to put it. Quite a few bugs surfaced during the first weekend that somehow months and months of QA testing hadn't found. I would like to apologize to everyone for this!

We have been so grateful for amazing reviews whilst we were in Early access. So it's hard to express the impact which hit all of us on the team when we started seeing our reviews going from ‘Very Positive' (between 87%-91% rating) down to just 'Mixed in the most recent reviews'. The impact on the team has been devastating. 😭😭😭
It was all fair though as the bugs were significant and we agree that this is unacceptable!

So over this week the team has worked above and beyond. We have even had to encourage them to be careful about taking time to stop and rest. But their commitment to trying to fix all the problems has been amazing - we are so grateful to them. This is a labor of love for us all and you, the players, deserve to have a game which delivers on its promised experience.

We are determined to get this right and to regain your faith in us - hopefully convert a few of those reviews back to positive. We have so much more planned in our future roadmap with new seasonal content, new missions, deeper bonds with the creatures and characters, etc etc.

We can now report that we believe we have solved all of the biggest issues. The temptation is to release this immediately but that would be a mistake. We need to make sure it has been tested extensively. It is imperative that we confirm that the fixes are out and that we haven’t accidentally introduced more issues.

For those of you who don't want to wait and want to be part of the process of checking, we have created a beta branch for you to try out. No expectations! And, obviously, we appreciate the support from anyone willing to take a look!
To access the beta branch click here (and don’t forget our discord channel):
Our aim is to launch this update on Monday 20th (subject to testing) 🚀🛠️
Sincerely,
Bendik

releases.displayName: Our Last Early Access Update Is Here, 30% Off!

items.text: At last, we are now ready with an extensive content update!

The game is pretty well finished. We have added quests and narrative, and even voice-over. We have adjusted and balanced the gameplay to give a better feel and make it more fun. We’ve made dramatic changes to the core game loop. We’ve even added Steam achievements!
Fair warning: With all these changes, the old save games will be incompatible and obsolete. Please start a new game for an optimal experience.
This is likely the final content update before launch. From now on, we will focus on fixing any remaining bugs and a bit of polish here and there.
Please see the list further down for detail about all the new content and features.
We hope you enjoy what we've prepared for you over these last months ♥

We are so eager to share the full story with you! The main story has been improved and we have added voiceovers from our awesome voice actors. Each of the characters you find on the island now has their own side quest/storyline bringing out their wonderful personalities.
All new main and side quests have been added to the game

The Bloombox!: We are giving you the freedom to choose your music! Well, you have to work for it. First, you need to craft a boombox, like an old gramophone. Then you need to explore the island and craft the discs you receive as rewards for building work orders. Each disk represents a different character, creature, or place. You can place the Bloombox wherever you like and play your favorite songs as you collect them.

Our new Day / Night system, the Cloud Cycle, traps players in an endless night until they sleep. As you might recall, mutated plants roam when the island is shrouded. So use this time to combat the mutated plants and gather their seeds to craft plants for your beautiful garden.: You can always go to sleep in your bed and skip the night, and as a new day begins we now display your progress in the Daily summary screen. Here you can see how many Ribbits you earned that day amongst many other things!

Is your thumb getting tired from picking up resources? Well, say hello to auto-pickup! Resources dropped from monsters and resource nodes now automatically pull toward you and are added to your inventory. It’s magic! ✨
We have done a complete visual pass on the island! Ikonei's colors should "pop" more, with improved lighting and foliage.
Voice acting has been added! English and Norwegian audio is available.
Multiple text languages have been added as well: English, Norwegian, German, Spanish, French, and Simplified Chinese.
Even your creatures are more talkative! They will now respond to your command, letting you know if they are willing to help out or not.
As the darkness creeps in your creatures will also get tired - go to sleep, and they will be back in action!
We also give you more freedom. You can bond and be one with your friend at level one!
A new unlockable island has emerged for players to explore (not showing this one to not spoil the fun!)
The island can be rebuilt further! New construction altars have arisen that offer crafting recipes.
There have been balance passes on all construction altars and shrines.
Crafting Recipes are now unlocked at Construction Altars and can be bought in shops.
Regions are now discovered by placing frogs on pedestals rather than fixing the shrines.
Tilling the ground will no longer work in rainy regions.
Players must first activate a nearby shrine to farm.
Pirates no longer dance when the region is rainy.
Players must first activate a nearby shrine to progress through a Pirate Camp.
And there is much more for players to discover!

releases.displayName: A Major Update is Coming to Ikonei Island!

notes.title: Dear Early Accessers and players of Ikonei Island: An Earthlock Adventure,

items.text: Hey there! First and foremost, we owe you a big apology for the long pause in updates and for not keeping you in the loop about the development of Ikonei Island. Our bad! We're truly sorry for leaving you hanging for so long.

But rest assured, it hasn't been a time of slacking off. In fact, we've been working hard to bring you an incredible game experience. Since the last patch, we've made significant progress by adding all the narrative, balancing the game, and incorporating more content. We've also addressed numerous bugs and even expanded the game to support multiple languages (Spanish, French, German, Norwegian, Simplified Chinese). However, all these presented unexpected challenges and resulted in unforeseen bugs that took longer to fix than anticipated.

Soon, we'll be releasing an Early Access patch that brings these updates to you. Following that, we'll be dedicating our efforts to bug fixing until the full launch. Unfortunately, there are still some multiplayer bugs that need to be squashed, but we're committed to resolving them.

We can't thank you enough for your unwavering support and patience throughout this journey. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we've taken it to heart in our quest to make Ikonei Island the game you deserve. Your dedication to the game has truly inspired us, and we're honored to have players like you as part of our community.
Now, let's dive into a (very) shortened preview of what's coming in the next update! We've got some exciting features lined up that we know you'll love:
New Day/Night system
Engaging storylines and captivating cutscenes
Introducing the Bloombox feature
Automatic pickup of dropped resources by nearby players
Added voice acting for an enhanced gaming experience

We're eager to share more details about these updates soon, so keep an eye out for further announcements. Your feedback remains crucial to us, so please continue to share your thoughts and suggestions.
Once again, we sincerely apologize for the radio silence and any inconvenience caused. We appreciate your understanding and unwavering support. Get ready to embark on an adventure like no other!
The Ikonei Island Development Team

items.text: Companions of level 2 & 3 are now able to destroy resource nodes of level 2 & 3 respectively, allowing progression again.

releases.displayName: Early Access First Major Update Release!

items.text: After tending to your crops, you decide to go for a walk on the beach with your critter friend. It runs past you, jumping, while you crouch to pick some frogs.
You hear your furry companion making noises, trying to alert you. But as you raise your head to check on it, you bump it into something and fall backwards.
What was that? As you stare forward, you see a wooden chest opening up. Your lil' pal stands by your side looking anxiously at it. On it, there's a plaque that reads:
You get up, approach the chest and stare inside. Here's what you see!
A castaway is never alone! Explore the island with all of your critter frens ♥
Wanna take a closer look when interacting with your lil' pals? We got you!
Companions can now be commanded to perform their actions! Bonding is no longer required, but still possible.
It's not pss pss pss, it's [insert name]! Give nicknames to your pals - which will be shown above their heads - and check how happy they are with the mood meter feature.
Creatures can now be fed, washed, and played with to increase their mood and experience bar!
Improved locomotion animations for all companions (Stormdog, Otterlot, Longhorn, Axepecker, and Bibi);
Improved creature summoning and dismissing;
Improved Hogbunny dismiss animation;
Extended animations for playing with the creatures;
Improved idle animation for Stormdog.
Have you ever dreamed of living in a tree house? Now you can!
You can also decorate a cave house however you like! We've prepared a lot of new placeables for you ♥!
You can even put all 3 houses in the same spot to make your own little hamlet if you wish!
You can use the crops on your farm to do all kinds of things, like restore health, feed your creatures or make some profit. To this end, we wanted to make sure that farming felt easy and fluid to do.
Orientation of tilled ground should now feel even better, and it will be easy to design your farm however you want!
We also wanted to speed up the process for players a bit, so players will now be instantly gratified with new crops after pollinating the plants with the Queen Bibi, or the Pollen Bag.
Seed Pods
Monsters now drop Seed Pods instead of Seeds, based on what region they’re in
These Seed Pods can be used to craft the different seeds that the enemies no longer drop
Petals refined in the Cutter now make Pollen Bags directly, no longer creating Pollen
Plant Definitions
Uprooting a plant now gives the relevant Seed Pod back
Although creatures remain the primary way to explore further into Ikonei Island, and collect raw materials, we felt that there were a couple of tools missing from the player kit.
Players will now have the ability to dig with their new shovel, and fish with their fishing rods. Get digging, and who knows what you might find!
Watering Can
Watering ability has had its radius reduced
Activate animation on water pump when refilling the Watering Can
Fishing Nodes
Added more fishing nodes in multiple areas

releases.displayName: September 16th - Crash Bug Fixes

items.text: Fixed issue with large save files causing long load times and potential crashes when saving.
Save files experiencing this issue will be fixed after the first Load & Save on the new patch version.
Depending on the size of the save file and computer hardware, the old file may take up to several minutes to load the first time.
Fixed issue that could cause a crash when starting or loading a game, or at the end of the first cutscene.
Error message if any: (LowLevelFatalError [File:Unknown] [Line:258])

issues.text: Grass is not rendering properly when farming and placing items on the ground.
The items sometimes could disappear from the screen but they will come back within 3-5 seconds.
Currently the game has significant performance issues on Xbox One, we’re working on it. It plays delightfully on Xbox X | S.
Currently the game has some performance issues on PS4, we’re working on it. It plays delightfully on PS5.

If you purchased the DLC but you are a guest on your friend’s island (who has no DLC), you will see an empty chest. We are fixing this issue. In the future, the player will be able to see the chest with your purchased DLC only on your island.
